title: MZ My simple, 16bit style RPG project.

posts.author: MObreck
posts.body:
Hello all, just wanted to promote my little project. For now I'm just posting some rough footnotes during the slow moments at my job. So here we go:
- Using MZ as the engine. Will be a freeware fangame, not commercial.
- in order to keep the project from collapsing under its on ambitions it's going to be a fairly small, simple project. I'm aiming for a size somewhere between Dragon Quest 2 and Final Fantasy 1.
- For now the team is me as lead developer and a writer. I'll be looking for more team members in a few weeks, even if just small time contributors.
- One of the more distinct features is I will be sticking to a mostly retro look. Like a more colorful early 16bit era jRPG.
- A lot of the graphical assets will be taken from RPGMaker 2 (SNES), 3 (PS1), 2000 and 2003.
- Will use a SNES style chiptune soundtrack. I impulsively bought several SNES style music packs during a sale
- The game will use a create-a-party style setup similar to Final Fantasy 1. However each class will have a male and female appearance choice and some classes may be fantasy races.
- The game will not likely be anything groundbreaking, but should have strong production values. I am an old timer who has been working with modding and devs kits since the mid 90s.
